name: mlflow
label: MLflow
description: MLflow 3.16.0 native RBAC authorization managed by Apache Ranger

resources.name: workspace
resources.validationMessage: Workspace must be an exact MLflow workspace name (e.g. default) or '*'. Partial wildcards are not supported by MLflow native RBAC.
resources.label: Workspace
resources.description: MLflow workspace name (default when workspaces are disabled, or named workspace). Granting USE or MANAGE on a workspace applies workspace-wide membership or administration.

resources.name: experiment
resources.validationMessage: Experiment must be an exact MLflow experiment ID/name or '*'. Partial wildcards are not supported by MLflow native RBAC.
resources.label: Experiment
resources.description: MLflow experiment ID (or name resolved to ID) or '*' for all experiments in the workspace. Governs runs, metrics, artifacts, traces, datasets, issues, and review queues under the experiment.

resources.name: registered_model
resources.validationMessage: Registered model must be an exact model name or '*'. Partial wildcards are not supported by MLflow native RBAC.
resources.label: Registered Model
resources.description: MLflow registered model name or '*' for all registered models in the workspace. Governs model versions, aliases, stages, and model artifacts.

resources.name: prompt
resources.validationMessage: Prompt must be an exact prompt name or '*'. Partial wildcards are not supported by MLflow native RBAC.
resources.label: Prompt
resources.description: MLflow prompt name (stored in the model registry with mlflow.prompt.is_prompt=true) or '*' for all prompts in the workspace.

resources.name: scorer
resources.validationMessage: Scorer must be '<experiment_id>/<url_encoded_scorer_name>' or '*'. Partial wildcards are not supported by MLflow native RBAC.
resources.label: Scorer
resources.description: MLflow evaluation scorer pattern '<experiment_id>/<url_encoded_scorer_name>' or '*' for all scorers in the workspace.

resources.name: gateway_secret
resources.validationMessage: Gateway secret must be an exact secret ID (or name) or '*'. Partial wildcards are not supported by MLflow native RBAC.
resources.label: Gateway Secret
resources.description: MLflow AI Gateway secret ID or '*' for all gateway secrets in the workspace.

resources.name: gateway_endpoint
resources.validationMessage: Gateway endpoint must be an exact endpoint ID (or name) or '*'. Partial wildcards are not supported by MLflow native RBAC.
resources.label: Gateway Endpoint
resources.description: MLflow AI Gateway endpoint ID or '*' for all gateway endpoints in the workspace. USE permission allows invoking the endpoint.

resources.name: gateway_model_definition
resources.validationMessage: Gateway model definition must be an exact model definition ID (or name) or '*'. Partial wildcards are not supported by MLflow native RBAC.
resources.label: Gateway Model Definition
resources.description: MLflow AI Gateway model definition ID or '*' for all gateway model definitions in the workspace.

resources.name: mcp_server
resources.validationMessage: MCP server must be an exact '<namespace>/<slug>' identifier or '*'. Partial wildcards are not supported by MLflow native RBAC.
resources.label: MCP Server
resources.description: MLflow MCP server name ('<namespace>/<slug>') or '*' for all MCP servers in the workspace.

configs.name: mlflow.url
configs.uiHint: {"TextFieldWithIcon":true, "info": "MLflow 3.16.0 Tracking Server base URL (started with --app-name basic-auth), e.g. http://mlflow.example.com:5000"}
configs.label: MLflow Tracking Server URL

configs.name: username
configs.uiHint: {"info": "MLflow admin username used for Test Connection and policy resource autocomplete via HTTP Basic Auth."}
configs.label: Username
